description: US sports betting lines from Action Network's scoreboard: games for a league and date (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college, WNBA, soccer) with teams, start time, status, broadcast, total bets tracked and full-game odds from each sportsbook feed (moneyline, spread with juice, total over/under, team totals), as published by Action Network. Books are identified by Action Network's book ID. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_vegasinsider when you need betting lines from VegasInsider's odds screens: every; sports_espn_college_football when you need ESPN college football scoreboard for one date: every game. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
